question: After the pacing bug is fixed, should outbound recovery keep ambiguous rows pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available, rather than moving them to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove either state transition, but pending recoverability versus fail-closed operator clarity is a product and operations tradeoff for existing ambiguous delivery rows.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
options.body: Merge after the no-op pacing fix if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation or operator surfacing ships.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep current main's terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery ledger is designed.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a doctor, UI, or API path before changing ambiguous rows to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
recommendation.body: Merge after the no-op pacing fix if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation or operator surfacing ships.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent co-author history on the same outbound recovery/storage semantics makes this the strongest available owner for the product tradeoff.
